subject: Engagement playbook prototype + week0 checklist (Everwell)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@everwell.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement playbook prototype + week0 checklist (Everwell)

Hi Ethan / Maya —

Per our call this morning, attaching the initial engagement playbook prototype and a compact week0 checklist to help the team accelerate a pilot kickoff. The goal here is to give Everwell a simple, exportable MAP that ties acceptance criteria to owners and dates.

What’s included (short):
- Google Doc: engagement_playbook_template.gdoc — editable MAP with lanes for goals, success metrics, owners, and risks.
- Week0 checklist (xlsx) — practical ops steps (accounts, keys, SSO, initial test prompts).
- Pilot timeline (xlsx) — a suggested 4-week cadence for tech validation -> acceptance.

A couple of asks from us:
1) Can you confirm stakeholders (tech, security, product) so we can add names/owners?
2) If week0 dates look tight, flag changes and we’ll adapt the timeline.

Next step I propose: quick co-edit session Tues 3/27 (30m) to lock owners and the acceptance matrix. If that works for you, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a shared doc.

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: engagement_playbook_template.gdoc (Google Doc stub), week0-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), pilot_timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@everwell.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement playbook prototype + week0 checklist (Everwell)

Looks good — quick notes after a skim:
- I added a tiny "Risks" column to the acceptance matrix (rows: perf, hallucination, data privacy) and suggested required test cases per risk.
- Proposed owner for infra checks: Marissa (if you’re good with that Marissa I’ll slot you).
- Recommend we keep the first week for integration smoke tests only (not customer-facing demos).

If Ethan/Maya are OK with a 3/27 co-edit, I’ll prepare a short tech checklist (10 items) they can run on day 0.

Jasmine
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

On Wed, 21 Mar 2028 at 09:12 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:

Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement playbook prototype + week0 checklist (Everwell)

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear starter. A few quick replies from our side:
- Stakeholders: Maya (Product), Omar Raza (Eng), and Leila Singh (Security). I’ve looped Maya here — Omar and Leila will be added to the doc after our internal sync.
- 3/27 works for a 30m co-edit at 10:00 PT for us. Please send invite.
- Timeline: the suggested 4-week pilot looks doable but can we shift the demo to week 5 to allow legal to finish a short data-flow review? Attached is our internal pilot_timeline.xlsx which has legal gate at end of week 3.

We’ll add owners on our side but would like Redwood to keep the acceptance matrix editable so we can iterate on the success metrics post-smoke test.

Ethan
Director of Product | Everwell Health

Attachments: pilot_timeline.xlsx (Everwell internal timeline)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Engagement playbook prototype + week0 checklist (Everwell)

Perfect — invite sent for Tue 27 Mar at 10:00 PT (30m). Agenda in the invite: 1) lock stakeholders/owners, 2) finalize week0 ops checklist, 3) confirm legal gate timing and demo target.

Marissa — assigning infra readiness (week0 ops) to you. Jasmine — can you bring the 10-item smoke checklist? I’ll bring the acceptance matrix view and a one-slide kickoff summary.

Ethan / Maya — I’ll keep the Google Doc editable for both teams. HubSpot deal updated with the doc link and timeline.

Cheers,
Hannah
Senior Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
